observations.finding: The actual UI already supplies approval route, expired approvals disclosure, credit preview warning, stale-payment control result, confirmation modal and chronological evidence. A tour can teach through these real elements.

Cream paper, dark green sidebar, lime primary action and serif invoice headings form a coherent visual identity. The full-page capture is tall and text-dense; a screenshot-only phone tour would be hard to read.
At <=870 px the payment rail is already ordered above the invoice, and reduced-motion rules exist. A new guide must retain these useful behaviors and avoid fixed overlays covering controls.

Recorded run contains original approvals, a 200 credit and a failed stale-revision transaction. It is a suitable evidence candidate subject to engineering verification of the complete run and final payment.

choice.autoplay: Omit in initial release; motion does not improve comprehension enough to justify timing and accessibility complexity.
choice.recording: Optional later artifact, not required for the public tour; do not delay reliable interactive publication.

uncertainties: SDE must establish whether shared presentation components or source-derived isolated scenes best avoid live API coupling.
Parent/SDE must verify one complete coherent evidence run and public URLs before selecting the replay dataset.
No first-time judge usability session has been observed; proposed clarity criteria require later real preview review.

selected_evidence_after_parent_context.reason: Latest settled run retains seven scenario-specific network proofs. The export also contains older-run proofs; filter to this scenario. No recovery tangent in main story.

rendering_plan.desktop: Guide appears above the real source-derived app content; full-width invoice and review rail stay readable. Use scene-specific accent/focus around the actual target action rather than a large tutorial overlay. Keep Back/Next accessible outside the app.
rendering_plan.mobile: Keep guide in document flow and use the existing app responsive ordering: payment review before invoice at narrow widths. Preserve text as HTML, not shrunken desktop screenshot. Place intended control and result adjacent where possible; scroll only on explicit navigation, with reduced motion respected.
rendering_plan.implementation_scope: tour/ and its builder script only; parent owns package/config. No live-source edits.
